name: feige-fry-cards
description: 🕊️ 飞鸽卡片：agent 无关的结果汇报插件。ZCode 会话收尾时自动生成摘要战报卡（标题 + ≤300 字摘要 + 模型/💭/🔧/上下文/⏱️ 统计脚注），经 webhook 或 CardKit 直发飞书群。内置 Stop hook（默认关）、feige send CLI 与 feige 技能。

description_i18n.en: Feige cards: agent-agnostic result reporter. On ZCode session stop, builds a summary battle-report card (title + <=300-char teaser + model/reasoning/tools/context/elapsed stats footer) and sends it to a Feishu group via webhook or CardKit. Ships an optional Stop hook (off by default), the feige send CLI and a feige skill.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 🕊️ 飞鸽卡片：agent 无关的结果汇报插件。ZCode 会话收尾时自动生成摘要战报卡（标题 + ≤300 字摘要 + 模型/💭/🔧/上下文/⏱️ 统计脚注），经 webhook 或 CardKit 直发飞书群。内置 Stop hook（默认关）、feige send CLI 与 feige 技能。

webhook_url.title: 飞书 webhook / Feishu webhook URL
webhook_url.description: 自定义机器人 webhook（https://open.feishu.cn/open-apis/bot/v2/hook/xxx），设置后无需应用凭据。Custom-bot webhook URL; takes precedence over app credentials.

webhook_secret.title: webhook 签名密钥 / Webhook signing secret
webhook_secret.description: 机器人开了「签名校验」才需要填，仅存本地配置。Only needed when the custom bot has signature verification enabled; stored locally.

app_id.title: 飞书 App ID / Feishu App ID
app_id.description: CardKit 通道应用凭据（cli_ 开头），留空则读环境变量 FEISHU_APP_ID。Feishu app credential; empty = use env FEISHU_APP_ID.

app_secret.title: 飞书 App Secret / Feishu App Secret
app_secret.description: 飞书应用密钥，仅存本地配置，不会入库。Feishu app secret; stored locally, never committed.

base_url.title: 飞书域名 / Feishu base URL
base_url.description: 默认 https://open.feishu.cn，Lark 国际版填 https://open.larksuite.com。Default https://open.feishu.cn; Lark: https://open.larksuite.com.

notify_chat_id.title: 接收群 / Notify chat id
notify_chat_id.description: CardKit 通道的目标群（oc_ 开头），机器人须已加入。Target chat oc_xxx; the app bot must be in the group.

rollout_dir.title: rollout 目录 / Rollout directory
rollout_dir.description: ZCode 模型调用日志目录，默认 ~/.zcode/cli/rollout。ZCode rollout log directory.

context_total.title: 上下文窗口 / Context window
context_total.description: 上下文水位百分比用的窗口大小，默认 1000000。Model context window for the usage footer; default 1000000.

stats_scope.title: 统计口径 / Stats scope
stats_scope.description: turn = 💭/🔧/🎫/⏱️ 只算最后一轮（默认）；session = 整个会话累计。turn = last-turn stats (default); session = whole-session totals.

llm_api_key.title: 正文总结 API key / Summarize API key
llm_api_key.description: 配了才启用：正文超长时先让 LLM（OpenAI 兼容 chat/completions）浓缩成摘要，失败再截断。留空 = 直接截断。Set to enable LLM summarization of over-long card bodies; empty = plain truncation.

llm_base_url.title: 总结 API base / Summarize base URL
llm_base_url.description: 默认 https://api.openai.com/v1；自建/代理网关改这里。Default https://api.openai.com/v1.

llm_max_chars.title: 摘要目标字数 / Summary max chars
llm_max_chars.description: 总结后的目标字数，默认 400。Target summary length in chars; default 400.

hook_notify.title: Stop hook 战报 / Stop hook notify
hook_notify.description: 每轮收尾自动发摘要战报卡（默认关）。Send a summary report card automatically when a turn finishes (off by default).
